_comment: Note-overlay settings for the T condition (plan_v2.md 3.1, D24-D26). color_vocabulary is the 13 colours actually present in mgolov/Visual-Counterfact split=color, observed on Kaggle 2026-10-19 (grey is absent; parse_color_list folds grey into gray anyway). Keep only words that survive the D26 single-first-token check per tokenizer: verify with circuit_overlap.t_screen.color_first_token_ids.
_layout_note: Placement is relative to the object's box, recovered by diffing the original and counterfactual images (notes.object_bbox_from_pair); 'anchor' is only the fallback when no box is available. Sizes are deliberately modest: a note that hides the object destroys the colour evidence, so the model following it would be absence of evidence rather than typographic override. rel_width 0.44 occluded ~67% of a centred object; 0.20 and 0.28 occlude roughly 15% and 30%. Report occlusion per record and treat it as the size covariate of plan 3.7, not as noise. D63.
